title.narrative: Apoyo a la focalizacin de subsidios energticos con proteccin a hogares vulnerables
Support to focalize energy subsidies while protecting vulnerable households

description.narrative: El objetivo general del programa es resguardar el consumo energtico de los hogares vulnerables, contribuyendo a la sostenibilidad fiscal y la progresividad del esquema de subsidios energticos. Los objetivos especficos del proyecto son: (i) mantener la asequibilidad del consumo del gas por redes para hogares vulnerables; (ii) apoyar a asegurar la asequibilidad del consumo del gas en garrafas para hogares vulnerables; y (iii) fortalecer las capacidades institucionales de la Secretara de Energa y del Ente Regulador del Gas para el diseo, implementacin y monitoreo del nuevo esquema de subsidios energticos.

The general objective of the program is to safeguard energy consumption for vulnerable households, contributing to fiscal sustainability and the progressivity of the energy subsidy scheme. The specific objectives of the project are: (i) to maintain the affordability of piped gas consumption for vulnerable households; (ii) to help ensure the affordability of bottled gas consumption for vulnerable households; and (iii) to strengthen the institutional capacities of the Ministry of Energy and the Gas Regulatory Authority for the design, implementation, and monitoring of the new energy subsidy scheme.
